prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 32 by 32 pixel sprite for an ESP32 round-screen forest chameleon pet game.
Primary request: draw one clearly recognizable small heap of animal droppings, three compact irregular rounded brown lumps piled naturally with one tiny tapered top. It should look like a tangible poop pile on the forest ground.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, isolated sprite only.
Style/medium: crisp retro pixel art with a visibly coarse 32 by 32 pixel grid enlarged to the output, hard square pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients.
Composition/framing: one sprite centered, occupies around 25 by 20 cells in a 32 by 32 square canvas, ample transparent margin, ground baseline near the bottom, front three-quarter view.
Color palette: maximum six earthy browns, very dark brown outline, warm tan highlights, dark brown undersides; no unrelated colors.
Constraints: no eyes, no mouth, no face, no emoji expression, no text, no watermark, no decorative flies, no scenery, no separate ground ellipse or background. Clearly readable simple physical item at tiny screen size.
